Ava (People Ops): FYI we've got a short handbook annex about data residency for teams handling EU/UK customer data. please skim the summary and sign the e-form: https://redwood.docs/internal/handbook/data-residency-addendum
Keaton (Legal): quick read 1. replace 'indefinitely stored' with 'retained per retention schedule'. i'll edit now.
Marta (People Ops EMEA): can we run two EMEA-friendly sessions next Tue? 09:30 & 16:00 GMT. i can host.
Ava (People Ops): sounds good. signup: https://forms.redwood/workplace/residency-training. RSVP by Fri EOD. US slot Wed 09:00 PT.
Jules (Eng Manager): who must sign? managers + folks with prod access?
Ava (People Ops): yep managers + any ICs with prod/customer-data access. contractors who never touch prod get a simple checkbox flow.
Jules (Eng Manager): ok i'll inventory my team and flag contractors.
hr-bot: Compliance task created: CR-2026-45. Manager signoff deadline in 6 days.
Ava (People Ops): i'll drop a short FAQ and two-line email template into #customer-success and the sales playbook after legal approves wording. thanks!
